name: open-poker
description: Open Poker — бесплатный open-source покер без реальных денег, в духе Lichess

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/engine && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/engine && concurrently -n engine,backend,frontend -c blue,green,magenta "npm run build:watch -w packages/engine" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
